title: "Hope Kingdom RPG Survival Server"
description: Hope Kingdom is a semi-government managed server with a semi-roleplay (RP) gameplay style. You are free to choose your role, whether it be a merchant, bandit, knight, civilian, or others, and experience a vibrant and diverse game world!
body:
About the Server
Hope Kingdom is a semi-government managed server that offers a semi-roleplay (RP) gameplay experience. You are free to choose your role, such as a merchant, bandit, knight, or civilian, and immerse yourself in a vibrant and diverse game world!

Server Features
Territory System: Create your own territory and protect your buildings!
No Item Drops on Death: Never worry about losing your items again!
One-click Tree Cutting: Collect materials quickly and build with ease!
Diverse Plugins: More gameplay features, more fun!
Semi-RP Gameplay: Players can freely choose roles such as merchant, bandit, knight, civilian, and more to enjoy a rich role-playing experience!
24/7 Admin Support: Administrators are online around the clock to address your issues and ensure the best gaming experience!
Server Rules
Do not use TMT to destroy other players' homes.
Cheating is strictly prohibited. If caught, you will be permanently banned.
Do not insult or use inappropriate language. Violators will be kicked from the server for 15 minutes; repeated violations will result in a permanent ban.
There aren't many rules, so we hope everyone can be self-disciplined and play peacefully.
Playing games is fun, but please don't bring negative emotions into the server!
Administrators are available 24/7. If you have any questions, feel free to ask on the server or join our Discord server.
How to Join Our Server
Server Name: Hope Kingdom
Server IP: ambitious-enderpearl133.modrinth.gg
Server Version: Minecraft 1.21.11
Please make sure your game version is correct, and enter the server IP in Multiplayer to join!

Races Introduction
In Hope Kingdom, you can choose from the following races, each with unique abilities and lore:

Angel: A benevolent race that came into being after a human accidentally transformed into a kind creature.

Origin: Humans who wore leather armor, held a feather, and died from a fall.
Racial Talents: Quickly regenerates energy over time.
Passive Skills: No fall damage, no water damage.
Active Skills: Flying Dash, Summon Cow, Summon Pig, Energy Recovery, Health Recovery.
Weaknesses: Cannot harm animals or humans, can only wear leather armor.
Demon: A sinister race transformed through a mysterious ritual.

Origin: Humans wearing chainmail, transformed after perishing in Nether lava.
Racial Talents: Naturally regenerates energy over time and regenerates energy quickly in lava.
Passive Skills: Immune to fire, immune to lava, quickly regenerates health in lava.
Active Skills: Shoot Fireball, Spawn Cobweb.
Weaknesses: Cannot wear armor other than chainmail.
Vampire: A dark creature with great power but a fear of sunlight.

Origin: Created by using the item "Blood of Cain." The first human to use it becomes the progenitor vampire. Humans killed by vampires are turned into vampires, but their power gradually weakens.
Racial Talents: Level bonuses, time-based bonuses, slow energy regeneration over time.
Passive Skills: Reduced damage underwater, fast health regeneration, increased melee damage, increased defense, truce with monsters, no fall damage.
Active Skills: Life Drain.
Weaknesses: Burns in sunlight without a golden helmet; takes increased damage from wooden weapons; can only eat raw meat.
Werewolf: A dark creature with immense power during the night.

Origin: Humans transformed after being killed by wolves on a dark night.
Racial Talents: Restores energy by killing creatures or eating raw meat at night; very slow energy regeneration over time.
Passive Skills: Fast health regeneration at night, increased melee and ranged attack damage, reduced fall damage.
Active Skills: Summon Wolf, Charge.
Weaknesses: Loses most abilities during the day.
Ghoul: A sinister creature that voluntarily gave up its humanity for eerie powers.

Origin: Humans transformed after being killed by Piglins or cursed by a Ghoul.
Racial Talents: Naturally regenerates energy over time.
Passive Skills: Truce with zombies, life drain in melee combat, drains energy from enemies in melee combat.
Active Skills: Summon Piglin, Evil Curse.
Weaknesses: Weak against water.
Demon Hunter: A stronger human race that unleashes its potential while hunting supernatural beings.

Origin: Humans who ascend after killing multiple other races.
Racial Talents: Slowly regenerates energy over time.
Passive Skills: Power Bow, Flame Bow, Binding Bow.
Active Skills: Switch Bow Modes.
Weaknesses: None.
Contact Us
If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to contact us through the following:

Discord Server: Join our Discord server
